## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what changes for the user.

## Verification

Record relevant commands/results and any untested platform, host or release boundary. For a bug, link the reproduction and regression test. Do not report a local build as publication or a browser engine simulation as a native platform run.

## Compatibility and provenance

Identify affected schema, rule, CLI, Skill or capability contracts. Link the ADR/compatibility decision and changeset when needed. Name third-party or generated material and its license/source.

## Contributor checks

- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under the repository's Apache-2.0 terms and signed off contribution commits under DCO 1.1.
- [ ] I removed confidential material, personal/facility identifiers, credentials and application session secrets from public content.
- [ ] I included relevant tests/docs and kept authored source files below 400 lines.
- [ ] I described validation limits and preserved unknowns and protected review records.

Report vulnerability details privately through SECURITY.md instead of this template.
